   • CVR: 1.02% → 1.12% (+10%, up (good))
   • AOV: 1,298 → 1,270 EGP (-2%, ~flat)
   *Who moved it:* *CVR 49%* of the move (helped, +99,400 EGP)  ·  *CPC 39%* of the move (helped, +14,871 EGP)  ·  *AOV 11%* of the move (hurt, -24,500 EGP).
   *Read:* *CVR* rose +10%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *99,400 EGP of revenue at the same clicks*.
     That drove ROAS +15%.
     Revenue +48% because spend +28%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *Marwa lf i wear*, its CVR went 1.84%→0.64% on 4,704 EGP spend (~29% of the swing).
